options_es: Limpiarla con aire comprimido y empacarla
Marcarla como Scrap por contaminación potencial
Triturarla inmediatamente junto con las coladas limpias
Lavarla con agua y jabón en el baño
options_en: Clean it with compressed air and pack it
Mark it as Scrap due to potential contamination
Crush it immediately along with clean runners
Wash it with soap and water in the bathroom

reasoning_en: In strict industries (automotive/medical/food), contact with the floor is automatic contamination.
